1. Split the channel with the 2-D discrete wavelet transform into an approximation and J levels of horizontal, vertical and diagonal details.
2. Estimate the noise sigma from the diagonal details of the finest level, unless it is set.
3. Choose a threshold for each detail subband with the threshold rule.
4. Shrink every detail coefficient with the soft or hard rule. Keep the approximation.
5. Rebuild the channel with the inverse transform and cut it to the image size.
